pool_note: 60 runs: 20 real ATL arrivals from DOT 2015 x 3 condition sets, pool seed 42, claude-haiku-5-5 agents

baselines.name: First come, first served (no gate coordination)

estimated.name: Time to decide
estimated.value: 10.2 s per negotiation vs 10 to 15 min of phone calls

failure_case.summary: WN3917 (fog + one runway closed + gates tight + shift ending): negotiation ended 9 cost points above the optimum
failure_case.what_happened: Concord settled on candidate cost 76 (57 min late, 0 missed connections); the omniscient optimiser found cost 66.
failure_case.why: Each desk only sees its own data, so the compromise the chief could build from their answers was not the cheapest legal option.
failure_case.fix: Let the chief show the soft cost of every legal option to all desks in round 2.
